title: Applicability of Article VII, Chapter 4
previewText:
The following special permit by the City Planning Commission shall not be applicable:

Section 74-142 (Electric utility substations). In lieu thereof, such use shall be allowed within the Special Willets Point District upon authorization of the City Planning Commission, pursuant to Section 124-16.
